verdict.rationale: Stripe documents a native Billing subscription analytics page that monitors overall performance and benchmarks metrics against similar businesses. It also offers recovery analytics on payment failures, so analytics come from the billing system itself rather than an export. However, the evidence never names MRR, churn, cohort retention or LTV specifically, and one older community comment says Stripe lacked the analytics Recurly offers. That comment is too general to count as a concrete contradiction. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of MRR, churn, cohort retention and LTV metrics; independent hands-on corroboration of the analytics' depth.
